records.summary: A prior review checked onboarding after an acquisition incentive change.
Customer complaints alone were judged insufficient to prove the incentive caused poor fit without matched cohort evidence.
Management abruptly suspended the mid-market direct acquisition bonus while investigating a suspected deal-quality problem.
Seller departures and pipeline disruption followed the abrupt suspension, while onboarding complaints did not improve. Management judged the broad suspension ineffective.
